# Introduction

This week marks the completion of the mini individual project. Students will present their work and reflect on teamwork and collaboration as we prepare to transition to the final project.

# Learning goals

1. Present and communicate the mini individual project

2. Reflect on project development and lessons learned

3. Understand team dynamics using the DISC framework

4. Prepare for the transition to the final team project

# Lecture - Q&A

Final questions and preparation for the mini project presentation.

# Lab - Mini Project Poster Presentations

Students present their mini individual projects and share their findings, approaches, and lessons learned.

# Discussion - DISC Assessment of the Team

Introduction to the DISC framework and assessment of team dynamics.

# Assignment

Complete the DISC assessment.

# Looking ahead

After this week, the course shifts from the **individual mini project to the final team project**. We will begin working with real-world agricultural data and project partners.
